answer.text: Both long call and long put positions because higher volatility benefits all option buyers

explanation.text: The Logic: Vega is POSITIVE for ALL long (bought) options: - Long call: positive vega (higher vol = higher premium = good for buyer) - Long put: positive vega (higher vol = higher premium = good for buyer) Short options have NEGATIVE vega (higher vol = higher premium = bad for writer). The Trap: Both calls AND puts benefit from higher volatility. More uncertainty helps ALL option buyers. Cross-Exam Context: Option writers prefer low/declining volatility. Option buyers prefer high/increasing volatility. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Long options: positive vega. Short options: negative vega. Vol up = all premiums up.
